The '''Engagement at Jestan''' was a successful mission carried out by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on [[Jestan]]. The success of the Alliance was due in large part to the tactical ability of [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Beryl Chiffonage]].<ref name="AIR" />
